bullets.text: Telco AI Startups Surge - **Telco AI** market projected to grow from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
Diverse 5G Strategies - **AT&T**, **Verizon**, and **T-Mobile** adopt distinct approaches to 5G infrastructure.
HCLTech Acquires HPE Unit - **HCLTech** buys **HPE**’s Telco Solutions for $160 million, focusing on AI-driven automation.
AI and Wi-Fi Convergence - **AI** will enhance **Wi-Fi** networks, making them smarter and more responsive by 2026.
6G's Architectural Shift - **6G** will embed intelligence in the radio layer, transforming network operations.
Huawei's AI Revolution - **Huawei** promotes **Agentic AI** to enhance efficiency and create new revenue streams for telcos.
Geospatial Analytics in Telecom - **Geospatial innovations** are reshaping network planning and customer insights.
AI Infrastructure Predictions - By 2026, intelligent network design will define competitive advantage in **AI** infrastructure.
Mobile Core Evolution - **AI**, edge access, and disaster protection will shape the mobile core's future in 2026.
